card.name: Digits and spaces before numbers
card.fires_on: The marked spot just before or inside a number, mostly the 9 in a year such as 1989 or a space before a year or a number range like 1 to 2 weeks.

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: The digit 9 or 0 in the middle of a four-digit year or trial code.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space right before a year or a count, as in a time span.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of family words, which hints at little useful output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before or inside a number, such as a year or a span of weeks.
